notes: GAAP city audit (CAFR extract). Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances, Total Governmental Funds (p5). Identity: 20,814,482 + 22,598,152 - 19,284,681 + 2,359,583 - 1,938,496 + lease proceeds 54,065 + sale proceeds 65,224 - correction of an error 111,163 = 24,557,166. The 'Change Within Financial Reporting Entity (Nonmajor to Major Fund)' line nets to zero in the total column. Business-type: Combined Utilities enterprise fund (p7): restated beginning 73,941,058 (73,829,895 + correction 111,163) + 34,924,377 - 27,953,692 - 421,087 + capital contributions 601,999 = 81,092,655. Internal service fund (governmental activities column of the proprietary statements) not included in the governmental fund lines. ending_cash = Cash and Cash Equivalents on the governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4); ending_investments = Investments 14,683,601 (also CDs 244,216 and restricted investments 123,666 there). Detail: General Fund budget schedule (p10, budgetary basis), nonmajor special revenue budget schedules (pp20-25), Debt Service (p26) and Capital Project Funds (p27) budget schedules; the combining nonmajor statement (pp11-16) is used only for the two funds without a budget schedule (South Sioux City Community Foundation, Misc Projects). Combined Utilities departmental schedule (pp17-19) by department column. Budget-basis taxes lines that don't tie to the GAAP property tax figures stay taxes (unlabeled); TIF funds' Taxes are property tax and sales-tax funds' Other Taxes are sales tax by fund name. Statistical pages 28-33 not used. Read pages 1-33 of 33
